claim.claim-text: a seat (2); a backrest (3) separated from the seat (2); and an upper support frame (8) to which the backrest (3) is rotatably attached at a position higher than the seat (2), wherein the upper support frame (8) includes:

a left side portion (9) and a right side portion (9) both extending forward at left and right sides of the seated person; and a rear portion (10) that continuously and integrally connects the left side portion (9) and the right side portion (9), the left side portion (9) and the right side portion (9) are connected to side support bodies (13) arranged on left and right sides of the seat (2) to be tiltable, characterized in that the backrest (3) is connected to the upper support frame (8) at a position lower than an upper-lower intermediate position of the backrest (3) to be tiltable rearward.
2. The chair according to claim 1, wherein

the left and right side support bodies (13) have a T-shape or an L-shape in a side view and have a front-rear longitudinal upper horizontal portion (15) and an upper-lower longitudinal strut portion (14), and the upper horizontal portion (15) is set to a height at which a seated person's elbow is placeable.
3. The chair according to claim 1 or 2, wherein the backrest (3) is connected to the rear portion of the upper support frame (8).

4. The chair according to any one of claims 1 to 3, wherein resistance when the backrest (3) tilts rearward relative to the upper support frame (8) is set to be larger than resistance when the upper support frame (8) tilts relative to the side support body (13).
5. The chair according to any one of claims 1 to 4, wherein the seat (2) is attached to a seat receiving member (7) so that it can be pushed forward by a seated person when rocking.
